archived_by: repo hygiene — Profile B residual archive (git slim plan)

residual_findings.title: Canvas patch routes can overwrite concurrently edited outline markdown body with stale pre-lock copy (CRITICAL)
residual_findings.note: Each write handler reads (initial_frontmatter, body) before acquiring RuntimeLockGuard; uses stale pre-lock body for atomic_write_outline. Compass §6.4 calls out that outline markdown body must remain V1.65 editor-owned. Fix: re-read body under lock; never use pre-lock body for persistence.
residual_findings.closure_note: Fixed in commit 78670211: patch_outline_structure, patch_outline_chapter, and patch_timeline_event now discard the pre-lock body snapshot and re-read frontmatter + body under RuntimeLockGuard. Added regression unit test patch_write_uses_body_from_locked_re_read.

residual_findings.title: u64/i64 type mismatch in outline_revision — silent unwrap_or(0) fallback (Warning)
residual_findings.note: OutlineFrontmatter.outline_revision is u64; OutlinePatchResponse.new_revision is i64 with minimum:1 schema contract. patch_ok uses i64::try_from(new_revision).unwrap_or(0). Fix: change OutlineFrontmatter.outline_revision to i64 to match wire contract (consistent with StrategyPatchResponse).
residual_findings.closure_note: Fixed in commit 78670211: OutlineFrontmatter.outline_revision changed to i64, matching OutlinePatchResponse.new_revision. Removed silent unwrap_or(0) in patch_ok; added outline_revision_u64() helper for wire boundaries that require unsigned values.

residual_findings.title: Successful outline chapter/structure mutations invalidate only outline query, leaving chapter data stale (Warning)
residual_findings.note: usePatchOutlineStructure/Chapter/TimelineEvent invalidate only queryKeys.outline.detail(workId). But structure/chapter patches also mutate work_chapters fields (volume, status, slug, planned_word_count) displayed by useChapters. Fix: invalidate queryKeys.chapters.lists() (and detail(workId, chapter) for chapter patches) on successful structure/chapter patches.
residual_findings.closure_note: Fixed in commit a6981dc8: usePatchOutlineStructure and usePatchOutlineChapter now invalidate queryKeys.chapters.lists(); usePatchOutlineChapter also invalidates the specific chapter detail query. usePatchTimelineEvent continues to invalidate only the outline detail query.

residual_findings.title: Outline page is not route-split; canvas UI enters Control Room bootstrap chunk (Warning)
residual_findings.note: OutlinePage imported statically; not lazy-loaded. V1.70/V1.72 canvas policy says canvas routes must be route-split. Fix: lazy-load OutlinePage behind /works/:workId/outline using same lazy + Suspense pattern as StrategyPage.
residual_findings.closure_note: Fixed in commit 7f615654: OutlinePage is now lazy-loaded via React.lazy + Suspense on /works/:workId/outline, producing a separate outline-page chunk in the production build.
